name: Pedoe
source:
An aristocrat, Ursin's father and the King's younger brother who also happens to possess a rather disturbing obsession with bears, to the point where everything he owns must have it.

He has forty-three wives and four hundred forty-four children in total, and it seems he intends Elcia to be his forty-fourth wife.
